scope: Obstfeld and Rogoff (1996), Chapter 7: global linkages and economic growth. Solow and its extensions with global convergence, Ramsey-Cass-Koopmans (existence, uniqueness, Euler plus transversality, monotone convergence), Weil OLG growth with the global saddle path, continuous-time limits, AK and learning by doing, Romer growth with transition dynamics, borrowing-constrained OLG, immigration, Brock-Mirman, the two-country RBC model, the log-linear RBC model and portfolio diversification and growth, with Appendices 7A-7B and the exercises.
source: Maurice Obstfeld and Kenneth Rogoff (1996), Foundations of International Macroeconomics, MIT Press, Chapter 7, pp. 429-512.
